steps.text: Talk to Launa east of Varrock.
choices: Would you like me to go down to look for your husband and son?

steps.text: Use a rope on the rift.
Enter the rift.
Take a weapon from the weapon rack. Kill the angry monsters with the appropriate weapon: Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Kill animals with appropriate weapons until the Rage Metre fills. Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Kill animals with appropriate weapons until the Rage Metre fills. Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Kill animals with appropriate weapons until the Rage Metre fills. Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Kill animals with appropriate weapons until the Rage Metre fills. Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Kill animals with appropriate weapons until the Rage Metre fills. Sword - Unicorn Spear - Bear Mace - Rat Battleaxe - Goblin
Go to the next room.
Look inside the Dark Holes to cause fear reapers to appear. Kill 5 of them. You cannot search the same hole over and over again.
Kill the Fear Reaper.
Continue to the next room.
Attack the confusion beasts until you find one which takes damage, and kill it. The others will take 8 hits to die.
Leave the room through the confusing door.
Kill each hopeless creature 3 times.
Continue through the exit of the room.
Kill all three of Tolna's heads.
Talk to Tolna.
Talk to Tolna outside the rift.

rewards: Access to the Dungeon of Tolna
